title: Hybrid Rerank
description: A hybrid search component that re-ranks documents already retrieved by an
upstream vector store, fusing their vector score with a BM25 keyword score
for improved ordering. Uses Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) to merge both
signals into a unified ranking that captures both semantic meaning and exact
keyword matches. It re-orders the retrieved candidate set rather than issuing
a fresh embedding lookup, so it cannot surface documents the vector store did
not return. Configurable alpha parameter controls the balance between vector
and keyword search. Ideal for RAG pipelines where neither pure semantic nor
pure keyword ordering alone is sufficient.
